resources.string: ascendy
ascendy app blocking

only while a focus session is active: reads the foreground app\'s name and the browser address bar to block the apps and sites on your list. everything is processed on-device and discarded immediately — nothing is stored or sent anywhere.
Focus session
Shown while a focus session is active.
Ascendy focus status
ascendy lockdown
while lockdown is on, ascendy can\'t be uninstalled until you turn lockdown off.
turning this off removes lockdown protection and lets ascendy be uninstalled. you can\'t do this while a focus session is active.
Protection alerts
Warns you when a blocking protection stops working during a session.
app & site blocking is off
accessibility was turned off mid-session — tap to switch it back on so blocking keeps working.
app blocking is degraded
usage access was revoked — tap to re-grant it so apps keep getting blocked.
site blocking is off
the blocking VPN was disconnected — tap to reconnect and keep sites blocked.
app blocking can\'t show its block screen
accessibility is off and the overlay permission is missing, so blocked apps open uncovered — tap to allow ascendy to appear over other apps.
this phone doesn\'t have that settings screen — open Settings and find it there.
